data.description: An olethrodaemon can convert life energy it has consumed into a potent breath weapon.  Up to three times per day, but no more often than once every 1d4 rounds, an olethrodaemon can expel a 120-foot line or a 60-foot cone of shrieking black smoke and wind one of its mouths as a standard action.  Any living creature in the area of this attack takes 20d10 points of damage from negative energy, or half on a successful DC %1 Reflex save.  Undead creatures caught in this negative energy are healed for the same amount instead of damaged.
data.name: Soul-Drained Breath
